title: Kurkuri Bhindi
description: Crispy shallow-fried okra tossed with chaat masala and amchur, a dry sabzi that stays crunchy.

ingredients.name: Okra
ingredients.notes: washed, dried and cut into thin strips

steps: Wash the okra and dry it completely with a clean towel, then slice into thin lengthwise strips.
Toss the okra with besan, rice flour, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt without adding water.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan on medium heat.
Spread the okra in a single layer and cook for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle the amchur and chaat masala just before serving.
